For our client located in Ostend, we are looking for a High Voltage Technician. This company specializes in large, high-quality projects in West and East Flanders.

  • Maintenance and repair of high-voltage installations;
  • Identifying and resolving malfunctions;
  • Correct administrative processing of interventions;
  • Performing inspections and troubleshooting;
  • Testing and commissioning electrical systems;
  • Collaborating with engineers and project teams for innovative solutions.
Our client in Ostend is looking for a new High Voltage Technician with the following qualities:

  • Technical background with experience in medium/high-voltage installations or a strong interest in the field;
  • BA5 certification and strong awareness of safety regulations;
  • You speak DUTCH or GOOD ENGLISH;
  • Eager to learn and motivated to grow into an independent role.

As Lead Full Stack Developer, you take a key role in the further development and evolution of a suite of business-critical applications used in real-time operational environments.
You remain strongly hands-on in both backend and frontend development, working primarily with .NET and Angular, while also guiding technical choices, improving existing implementations and helping shape upcoming solutions. You challenge current approaches where needed and translate complex technical topics into clear and pragmatic proposals.
A major part of the role is technical leadership. You support and coach other developers, promote knowledge sharing and help maintain high standards in code quality, maintainability and software design. You work closely with analysts, architects, testers and other developers within an Agile/Scrum setup.
You also keep a close eye on delivery, scope and technical risks. When dependencies, architectural concerns or implementation issues arise, you identify them early and help the team move towards a robust and sustainable solution.

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in IT (or equivalent through strong experience)
• Senior professional experience in .NET & Angular
• +15 years of experience in IT
• You're a pragmatic team player
• You work in English and understand Dutch & French

Our client is a well-established company operating in all segments of passenger transport, including public transport, school and company transport, and coach tourism services. With multiple locations across Belgium and Luxembourg, they are looking for a skilled Bus Mechanic to strengthen their garage team in Affligem or Lede.

Jobomschrijving

 

Your Responsibilities
	
• Independently perform both simple and complex mechanical and electrical repairs and installations on buses.	
• Carry out preventive maintenance and diagnostics.	
• Report all maintenance and repair work accurately using the company's garage application.	
• Take the lead when necessary and provide support and guidance to fellow technicians.	
• Participate in technical training courses provided by various bus manufacturers.

You have a solid technical background in vehicle mechanics.

You have knowledge of vehicle electronics and can read electrical diagrams.

You are passionate about technology and work accurately, safely, and independently.

You hold a technical secondary education (TSO) diploma in Automotive Technology or have equivalent experience.

You are proactive, able to identify technical issues, and find effective solutions.

You communicate well in English, Dutch, or French.

Experience with the maintenance of suspension systems, brakes, filters, and general vehicle servicing is required.

Experience working on trucks is an advantage; experience with buses is even better.

A Category B driving licence is considered an asset, as occasional roadside assistance may be required.

Responsibilities

• Architect and optimize Python-based software applications for core business activities.
• Collaborate with stakeholders to define technical specifications and gather requirements.
• Implement best practices for code quality, testing, and CI/CD pipelines.
• Mentor team members through code reviews and technical leadership.
• Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues within the monitoring and alerting engines.
• Ensure the security, scalability, and maintainability of event-driven solutions.

Requirements

• 6+ years of experience in software development.
• 3+ years of expertise in backend development with Python, FastAPI, and Pydantic.
• You possess strong experience with AsyncIO.
• You have a solid background in data and integration using SQL, specifically MSSQL or PostgreSQL.
• You bring experience with message brokers such as RabbitMQ.
• You possess deep knowledge of service-based architectures and event-driven systems.
• You have a strong understanding of software design patterns, data structures, and algorithms.
• You're experienced in implementing IT security requirements within critical infrastructure environments.
• You bring experience working in Agile environments and have a proactive, solution-oriented mindset.
• You are fluent in English with a good level of Dutch and/or French.
Nice to Haves

• Experience with Azure cloud services.
• Knowledge of NoSQL solutions and test automation frameworks like Selenium.
• Familiarity with containerization using Docker and CI/CD deployment pipelines.
• Experience with legacy code refactoring initiatives.
• Proficiency in German.

Known for being accessible, nearby, and highly engaged, they are dedicated to delivering exceptional service and maintaining strong relationships with their clients. Jobomschrijving

Main Responsibilities:

Our client, based in Antwerp, is active in logistics. 

Jobomschrijving

As a Freight Forwarder export, you are responsible for coordinating and monitoring domestic and international shipments and serve as the point of contact for customers, carriers, and internal stakeholders.

Your main responsibilities:
	
• Organizing and coordinating shipments by road, rail, sea, and air	
• Operational monitoring of shipments (including sailings, railcars, and HSE)	
• Preparing and processing transport and shipping documents (including Bill of Lading, Letter of Instruction, Dispatch...)	
• Receiving and processing customs documents	
• Managing and updating transportation information and procedures (including in SharePoint)	
• Preparing and sending container and cargo manifests	
• Informing customers about costs, transit times, and shipment status	
• Ensuring accurate record-keeping and a smooth handoff within the team

Who are you?
	
• Minimum A2 diploma 	
• Minimum 2–5 years of relevant experience as a freight forwarder export or in a similar role	
• Strong operational knowledge of freight forwarding and logistics processes	
• Knowledge of transport documentation and IT systems	
• An IMDG certificate (dangerous goods) is a strong asset	
• Fluent in Dutch and English, both verbally and in writing	
• Meticulous, able to handle stress, customer-focused, and a strong communicator	
• Able to work independently and manage priorities
